datasetDef: OpenNeuro ds000030 (UCLA CNP LA5c, CC0, DOI 10.18112/openneuro.ds000030.v1.0.0; Poldrack et al. Sci Data 2016): FreeSurfer stats tables from the curators' derivatives (Gorgolewski et al. F1000Research 2017) — no raw MRI touched. 265 subjects with usable stats: 125 controls, 50 schizophrenia, 49 bipolar, 41 ADHD. Classification is a sanity check that the morphometric representation carries known group signal — NOT diagnosis; single-dataset effect sizes are not meta-analytic consensus.
preprocessing: One vector per subject: 68 DK mean cortical thicknesses + 15 aseg volumes / eTIV, columns keyed to NOESIS atlas region ids. Age + gender residualized per fold (confound regression fit on train only, applied to the held-out subject).
model: StandardScaler + L2 logistic regression, leave-one-subject-out CV, pooled ROC-AUC; 500 label permutations refitting the full LOSO loop (p = (1+#perm>=obs)/(1+N)); subject-bootstrap 95% CI (2000 resamples). SCHZ/BIPOLAR/ADHD each vs CONTROL.
